basis: Standalone · Indian Railway Finance Corporation alone
coverage: Whole company · railway leasing and financing
incomeDefinition: Total income includes lease income, interest, dividends and other income. The amounts are income before funding and other costs; returning the original amount borrowed is not income.
definition: The audited company’s earnings after all reported expenses and tax. The statement records no income-tax expense this year.
sourceLabel: Audited annual results filed on 14 May 2026
location: PDF page 3 · annual audited income statement; page 6 · notes 2–4 and 8–11
notes: Lease income was ₹17,726.00 crore and interest income ₹9,539.83 crore. Finance costs were ₹20,005.26 crore and the amount charged for expected losses on financial items was ₹124.03 crore. Profit before and after tax is the same this year under the accounting and tax treatment described in notes 2 and 3. The company did not report separate operating segments or have any controlled companies, associates or joint ventures at this year-end.
insight: Borrowing costs absorb a substantial part of lease and interest income. The disclosed income categories do not show separate profits for coaches, wagons or particular railway projects. Money still owed under a lease is not payment already collected.
